CDS Protocol D - Cancer

Protocol cds protocol cancer oncology

Evidence: Grade C (scientific)

Summary

Cancer-focused CDS protocol with increased dosing for tumor support. Higher concentration and frequency for aggressive malignancy treatment.

Indications

  • Cancer support
  • Tumor adjunct therapy
  • Aggressive malignancy

Contraindications

  • Concurrent chemotherapy
  • Concurrent radiation
  • Autoimmune conditions

Steps

  1. Consult with healthcare provider for cancer diagnosis
  2. Prepare increased dose of CDS in purified water
  3. Follow protocol dosing schedule
  4. Monitor for adverse reactions
  5. Coordinate with oncology care team

Dosage

Higher dose CDS protocol for cancer: 2-3 ml CDS in 100ml water, 2-3 times daily

Expected Outcomes

  • Cancer support through immune system activation
  • Tumor reduction adjunct
  • Systemic detoxification

Monitoring

  • Monitor for signs of detox reaction
  • Work with oncology team
  • Track tumor markers if appropriate
  • Watch for medication interactions

Frequency: 2-3 times daily
